parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Pitt Meadows · South Bonson and Fraser Way
South Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.

The City uses the name “South Bonson” for parts of the south end of Bonson Road: its South Bonson Community Centre is at 10932 Barnston View Road, and its Athletic Park page puts the park beside the arena “in the South Bonson area”.

My working description, from those addresses only and not an official boundary: the part of Bonson Road south of Hammond Road and the CP rail line, down to the Fraser River, with Fraser Way and Barnston View Road. My
Mid Meadows guide
covers the schools and fields further north on Bonson Road.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Pitt Meadows and School District 42.
General information only.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations, flood rules and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Quick facts

Transit

Route 722 (Bonson / Meadowtown) is a loop. It goes along Harris Road, Ford Road and 190A Street, then Hammond Road and Blakely Road, 116B Avenue and Bonson Road, ending at Fraser Way and the Barnston View roundabout. One of its stops is Pitt Meadows Station.
Route 719 (Fraser Way / Meadowtown) picks up where the 722 leaves off. It runs on Wildwood, Hammond Road, Bonson Road and Fraser Way, then arrives at Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for South Meadows

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

On September 27, 2022 the City adopted “I See Pitt Meadows 2040” as its Official Community Plan. Goal 2 is about farmland being protected for food production, with agriculture as the dominant use of land. Goal 5 calls for a compact, walkable community and a range of housing options.
I found no separate neighbourhood plan for South Bonson or South Meadows on the City pages I read.

The Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District takes in 3,546 hectares, 3,136 of them in Pitt Meadows. The City identifies drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) as the urban development area, served by ditches, culverts and storm sewers. Low-lying catchments empty into the Pitt, Alouette and Fraser Rivers by way of floodboxes and pump stations.
The City says that it is almost completely protected by 60 km of dikes, which keep river flooding away from low-lying areas and key infrastructure.
The City says Pitt Meadows is at risk of flooding annually in May and June.
Per the City’s Financial Plan 2026–2030, more than 85% of the land base in Pitt Meadows is within the Fraser, Pitt and Alouette rivers’ floodplains.
The Financial Plan 2026–2030 from the City describes land use in Pitt Meadows as still predominantly agricultural, with 78% of the land inside the Agricultural Land Reserve.
The built-up part of the south end is urban; I found no City statement on how much of this MLS area is ALR.

According to the City, Pitt Meadows Station, located in the urban core, is the only West Coast Express station in Pitt Meadows. It sits on Harris Road, and that road falls in my Central Meadows guide area rather than South Meadows.
Route 595 (Langley Centre / Maple Meadows Station) never enters Pitt Meadows. It connects Langley Centre with Maple Meadows Station, which is in Maple Ridge.
For a specific lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone and the plan designation.

blocks.text: Before you buy in South Meadows

parts.t: Check the flood and drainage rules for the lot.
Check with the City on how the dikes, drainage and floodplain mapping affect the specific address, particularly where a basement or an addition is involved.
Check what the plan allows nearby.
Because new buildings can change a street, check with the City about what the Official Community Plan designations permit on the neighbouring lots.
Confirm the school catchment.
Ask SD42 for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Check the ALR on any larger lot.
Look up the address on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything on farmland.
Where is South Meadows?
South Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s South Bonson Community Centre is at 10932 Barnston View Road, and the City puts the Athletic Park beside the arena in the South Bonson area.
How do I get around from South Meadows?

Pitt Meadows Station is a stop on Route 722 (Bonson / Meadowtown), a loop made up of Bonson Road, 116B Avenue, Blakely Road and Hammond Road, together with Harris Road, Ford Road and 190A Street, that connects to Fraser Way and the Barnston View roundabout.
After the 722, Route 719 (Fraser Way / Meadowtown) carries on via Fraser Way and Bonson Road, then Wildwood and Hammond Road, finishing at Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.
Timetable dates: the 722 and 719 routes took effect September 7, 2026, according to TransLink’s timetable PDFs, which I read on October 18, 2026. Check the current timetable.

Pitt Meadows has a single West Coast Express station, Pitt Meadows Station, and the City places it in the urban core. The station is on Harris Road, which belongs to my Central Meadows guide area and not to South Meadows.
Which schools are near South Meadows?

I found no school on the Province’s SD42 list with a South Bonson address. Edith McDermott Elementary is at 12178 Bonson Road, Davie Jones Elementary is at 12030 Blakely Road and Pitt Meadows Elementary is at 11941 Harris Road, all Kindergarten to 7.

Pitt Meadows Secondary, at 19438 116B Avenue, serves Grades 8 to 12. It is the sole public secondary school in Pitt Meadows according to the Province’s SD42 list, and the Province says that a new school on that same property should open to students by fall 2029.
Catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with
School District 42 (SD42)
What parks and recreation are there?

The South Bonson Community Centre and Pitt Meadows Art Gallery are at 10932 Barnston View Road, Shoreline Park is at 51 Bonson Road, Bonson Park is at 11546 Bonson Road, and the Athletic Park and Arena are at 11431 and 11435 Bonson Road.

You’ll find the Pitt Meadows Public Library at 200 – 12099 Harris Road, within the civic centre close to City Hall and the Family Recreation Centre. Pitt Meadows has no other library branch that I could find.
What plan covers South Meadows?

“I See Pitt Meadows 2040” is the Official Community Plan the City adopted on September 27, 2022. Goal 2 envisions agriculture as the dominant land use, with farmland safeguarded for growing food. Goal 5 envisions a compact and walkable community offering a range of housing options.
I found no separate neighbourhood plan for South Bonson or South Meadows.
Is South Meadows in a floodplain?

The Diking District for Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge covers 3,546 hectares, of which 3,136 lie in Pitt Meadows. The City says drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) makes up the urban development area, with ditches, culverts and storm sewers, and that floodboxes and pump stations move water from low-lying catchments to the Pitt, Alouette and Fraser Rivers.
The City says Pitt Meadows is at risk of flooding annually in May and June.
Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
What are the homes and lots like?
I found no official description of home types for South Bonson or South Meadows.

Lot size (an MLS sales data figure, not from an official source): houses of the detached type sold from July 1 through October 8, 2026 had a median lot of 7,204 sq ft, using the 10 sales with a recorded lot size.
